svg.text: Task invariant: I1: a leased or running task has exactly 1 unexpired lease and 1 live attempt.
Task invariant: I2: no task is ready while a dependency is not done.
Task invariant: Only a VerifiedVerdict from the verification module moves a task to done (RR-3, define N1).
Task invariant: A reap ends the attempt and requeues the task in 1 transaction before any signal (04 S7).
Task invariant: A usage limit burns no attempt (RR-11).
Task invariant: An operator requeue resets the attempt count through attempt_floor (04 L8).
Task invariant: A task has at most max_attempts attempts, then 1 replan, then escalation (RR-6).
Verification invariant: A verdict is verified only when result.json validates and the check passes in the worker sandbox.
Verification invariant: A code kind is verified only after the review scripts pass (V-14 limits).
Verification invariant: A judgment kind is verified only with no open CRITICAL judge finding.
Verification invariant: At most 2 critical fix rounds, then the task escalates.
Verification invariant: A second judge raises no new MEDIUM or LOW finding.

Port TaskExecutionCommands (driving) via ReconcilePassDriver (fleet-runtime) and CommandChannelHandler: one operation per use case; called by the reconcile pass, the file ingester and the command channel.
Port TaskExecutionQueries (driving): read models StartFile, JudgeFindings, NeedsYouQueue; used by horch CLI read-only commands.

Port TaskExecutionEventHandlers (driving) via InProcessReconcileConsumer: policies on plan-committed, plan-refused, task-replanned, question-answered, own-assumption-recorded, worktree-created, rescue-failed,
task-branch-conflicted, resolver-task-opened; at-least-once, idempotent on the connect key.

Port AttemptFileIngest (driving) via OutboxFileIngester (atomic files, ingested table): result.json, exit.json, heartbeat.json, progress and usage-limit files of an attempt outbox (write-result, attempt-exited,
usage-limit-reported); 1 ingestion per (path, sha256).
Port TaskRepository (driven) via SqliteTaskRepository: load and save Task with its Attempts and Lease through the one-door transition function of fleet-runtime.
Port VerificationRepository (driven) via SqliteVerificationRepository: load and save Verification by task id.
Port EventPublisher (driven) via LedgerEventLog: writes the event row in the same ledger transaction as the state change; consumers react in the reconcile pass.
Port LaunchEnvironmentGateway (driven) via InProcessWorkerProfiles: asks worker-profiles for the launch environment of a profile (sync, in-process).
Port AgentProcessGateway (driven) via InProcessFleetRuntime: calls fleet-runtime start-agent-process and stop-process-group; never inside a ledger transaction.

Port CheckRunner (driven) via SandboxedCheckRunner (wraps taskledger::finish review scripts): runs the acceptance command and the review scripts in the worktree in the worker sandbox, with the V-10 timeout.
Port LivenessProbe (driven) via PlatformLivenessProbe (platform layer, procid, herdr adapter): process alive with start time, heartbeat age, last activity, herdr agent state.
Port QuotaGateway (driven) via CliQuotaProbe (routing::quota): pool usage window and reset time from the CLI clients (06 S13).
Port NeedsYouInbox (driven) via NeedsYouFolder: writes needs-you files and posts a herdr notification.
Port Clock (driven) via PlatformAwakeClock: awake time for leases and stall rungs (PL-4).
